show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/WKAYwD
show.description: Talented jewellery artist Vivaan secretly loves his boss Myra and spends years helping build her dream company. But when her former lover Neil returns with an AI-powered design machine, Vivaan is humiliated, replaced, and falsely accused of sabotage. Heartbroken, he leaves and transforms himself into a powerful businessman. As Myra uncovers the truth about his sacrifices and loyalty, she realizes too late that the man she ignored may be lost forever.
